item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"Candidate B is substantially closer to the frozen contract: it adds the exact FilesService.Upload signature, uses multipartbody.NewFile, and delegates to FilesService.Add. Candidate A changes the required API and expands into explicitly prohibited option and retry refactors.","reasons":["B implements Upload(ctx, fileName, content, opts ...FilesOption) exactly as specified.","B encodes field \"file\" with multipartbody.NewFile and routes the replayable body through Add, preserving centralized option, request, decoding, and error behavior.","B validates empty filenames and nil content before encoding; errors from NewFile, including source-reader failures, are propagated unchanged.","A uses opts ...UploadFileOption instead of the required ...FilesOption and bypasses Add by duplicating its request and response logic inside Upload_Candidate A adds association fields and arbitrary multipart fields despite the explicit instruction not to add association fields. A also introduces several public option interfaces and changes existing option-constructor return types unnecessarily_Candidate A refactors generic request-body replay and changes Add/Update retry and body-closing semantics, directly conflicting with the instruction not to refactor unrelated retry machinery or change Add behavior_B's retry test uses a non-seekable source, demonstrating that Upload buffers content into a replayable body before the retry transport sees it."],"risks_a":["Major contract violations: wrong Upload signature, no delegation through Add, prohibited association APIs, and broad retry machinery changes.","The seekable-body replay implementation shares one seeker across GetBody calls, changes ownership/closing semantics, and introduces generic transport complexity beyond the requested fix.","Large documentation and API expansion increase review and compatibility burden without being requested."],"risks_b":["Adds unrelated PersonsService.UploadPicture, violating scope discipline and the requirement to add exactly the requested convenience API.","Upload tests do not assert the uploaded file content, and there are no explicit tests for argument validation or source-reader errors, despite the contract requesting them.","The multipart assertion only checks a Content-Type prefix rather than parsing and validating the media type and boundary robustly."]}
